description: This file declares classes and interfaces for mocking asynchronous proxy resolution, including MockAsyncProxyResolver, MockAsyncProxyResolverFactory, and ForwardingProxyResolver, used for testing proxy resolution behavior.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolver
classes.description: A mock implementation of an asynchronous proxy resolver for testing purposes.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolver::Job
classes.description: Represents a proxy resolution job that can be completed manually.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolver::RequestImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ProxyResolver::Request for mock jobs.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolverFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create mock proxy resolvers for testing.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolverFactory::Request
classes.description: Reference-counted request object for creating proxy resolvers.

classes.name: ForwardingProxyResolver
classes.description: A proxy resolver that forwards requests to another resolver.

methods.name: GetProxyForURL
methods.description: Method to get proxy information for a URL asynchronously.

methods.name: CompleteNow
methods.description: Completes a proxy resolution job immediately.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the load state of the request.
